name: Product route hero
purpose: The opening block of all 10 product routes: a short product name, a three-sentence positioning paragraph, a CTA pair, and a wide product screenshot.

motion.detail: Only the body paragraph carries an entrance class (delay 250ms, duration 500ms, distance 12px, ease-out). The heading, CTAs and image do not.

layoutNote: The h1 sits at a fixed 120px offset below the section top on every route, but EVERYTHING below it is normal document flow with fixed margins, not fixed absolute y. Verified by comparing /wallet's 3-line paragraph (buttons at y=488) against /vault's 2-line paragraph (y=464): both are exactly 80px below the paragraph's real bottom edge. Build as flow + margins so it self-adjusts per route.
